intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the landing pad from above.
Phase 2: Controlled descent with main engine braking to reduce vertical speed.
Phase 3: Final alignment and soft touchdown with both legs contacting the pad.

component_scale_reasoning.objective_success_bonus: Large positive reward (+100) for achieving both legs contact near pad with low velocities, to make sparse success reachable.
component_scale_reasoning.progress_shaping: Moderate positive reward for reducing distance to pad (up to +0.5 per step) and reducing vertical speed (up to +0.3 per step) to guide descent.
component_scale_reasoning.upright_angle_bonus: Small positive reward (+0.1) for angle near zero to encourage stable orientation.
component_scale_reasoning.main_engine_usage_penalty: Mild penalty (-0.03 per unit m_power) to discourage excessive fuel use, but not so large as to prevent necessary braking.
component_scale_reasoning.orientation_engine_penalty: Very mild penalty (-0.01 per unit s_power) to avoid discouraging necessary stabilization.
component_scale_reasoning.crash_penalty: Strong negative reward (-100) for termination due to crash or out-of-bounds to discourage unsafe behavior.
component_scale_reasoning.time_penalty: Small negative reward (-0.01 per step) to encourage faster landing.
